questions.prompt: What should the next attempt test?
questions.answer: The specific improvement on a comparable new task.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only; use answer-specific feedback.
scoring.practice: Provides specific, evidence-based feedback, incorporates correction and designs a comparable retest.
scoring.transfer: Produce feedback for two fictional practice attempts using the same criteria. Include one strength, one gap, a learner correction, a revised action and a novel retest. Explain why confidence ratings are not a substitute for task evidence.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
